capabilities: Arrange draggable, resizable widget cards on a dashboard with auto-saved positions
View xlsx, docx, pptx, code, image, and video files inside the dashboard
Transcribe audio and video files via right-click using OpenAI-compatible APIs
Translate the dashboard UI into any language with an AI API
Switch between 8 built-in dashboard themes and clone module instances
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not a theme pack; it is a widget dashboard that also ships 8 built-in color themes.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; AI features require an OpenAI-compatible endpoint and some weather providers need an API key, but Open-Meteo, wttr.in, and other providers work keyless.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in customizable start page where widgets like weather, stats, to-dos, and file previews can be freely arranged and resized in one view.

relations.evidence: OpenAI, DeepSeek, Moonshot, or any OpenAI-compatible API
faster-whisper-server, LocalAI, docker-whisper — any OpenAI-compatible /v1/audio/transcriptions service
SiliconFlow (TeleSpeech ASR, free tier), Groq (Whisper, free tier), Cloudflare Workers AI

requires.name: Amap or OpenWeatherMap key for some weather providers

summary: Free-layout dashboard with draggable, auto-saved widget cards: 25 built-in modules, 8 themes, a multi-format file viewer, AI translation, and audio transcription.
